headline: The European Commission has launched a campaign in Dublin in which companies, starting with NVIDIA, pledge tools, training and computing access to European scientists.
score_reason: Official launch with concrete company pledges, but no new funding and only one company's pledge was checked.
importance_line: Smaller labs, early-career scientists and startups in Europe may find tools and computing easier to reach, but no new money was announced and the supercomputer figures are NVIDIA's own projection.
summary: NVIDIA says on its blog that the European Commission launched the AI in Science Enablers Initiative at a summit in Dublin on 15 Oct, tied to RAISE, the Resource for AI Science in Europe, and that it is joining with open models and software, free course materials and access to European supercomputing centres. Research Commissioner Ekaterina Zaharieva said the campaign turns ambition into "concrete commitments".
notes: Original Science|Business page returned 403; entry built from Blockchain.News and NVIDIA's own blog post. Only NVIDIA's pledge was read in detail.
